title: Lighting
summary: Technical design for opt-in, integer, theme-agnostic lighting: light field model, crate placement, viewshed gate, rendering, save and determinism rules, phases, tests and risks.
notes: Design doc under docs/design/ (no filename convention). Competing signals: SPEC (data model structs, crate/component/system contracts, determinism and cost constraints, test list) vs ADR (explicit 'three decisions that shape everything else') vs DOC (prose rationale). Resolved to SPEC: it is a multi-decision technical design, not a single Context/Decision/Consequences record. Status line is mixed - phases A to C built 2026-09-11, phases D to F proposed - so the built parts (gate in update_viewsheds only, separate brightness and colour channels, opt-in via Lighting resource, integer falloff, sorted emitters for determinism) are effectively in force, while D to F are not locked. Filename uses 'unhashed' suffix because no shell was available to compute the SHA-256 of the source path; parent directory prefix added to avoid collisions.
